title: Equity and Aggregate Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2611.26197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Equitable resource allocations in the context of symmetric risk exposures are intuitively desirable and sometimes even expected in public planning. However, public planners generally are also concerned with mitigating risk and, more generally, uncertainty and ambiguity. We study a fundamental conflict between equity and ambiguity avoidance in public risk allocation problems. Our main results are framed and established in the setting of general symmetric aggregate losses equipped with dependence uncertainty among individual losses. Specializing to the classical model of Keeney (1980), we prove that an increase in equity is equivalent to an increase in aggregate ambiguity. We then provide a quantitative characterization of equity and ambiguity avoidance through the $\alpha$-maxmin preference framework, establishing conditions on ambiguity and risk attitudes under which each criterion holds. translated_abstract: 在对称风险暴露的情境下，公平的资源分配在直觉上是理想的，在公共规划中有时甚至是被期望的。然而，公共规划者通常还关注风险缓解，以及更广泛地说，不确定性和模糊性的缓解。我们研究了公共风险分配问题中公平性与模糊性规避之间的根本冲突。我们的主要结果是在一般对称总体损失的框架下建立和证明的，其中个体损失之间存在依赖性不确定性。专门针对Keeney（1980）的经典模型，我们证明公平性的增加等同于总体模糊性的增加。然后，我们通过α-maxmin偏好框架对公平性和模糊性规避提供了定量刻画，建立了在何种模糊性和风险态度条件下各项准则成立。具体而言，公平性对应于模糊性……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 这篇论文证明了在公共风险分配问题中，公平性的增加等同于总体模糊性的增加，揭示了公平与模糊性规避之间存在根本性冲突，并通过α-maxmin偏好框架对两者进行了定量刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in public risk allocation problems, an increase in equity is equivalent to an increase in aggregate ambiguity, revealing a fundamental conflict between equity and ambiguity avoidance, and provides a quantitative characterization of both through the α-maxmin preference framework.
